annotations.title: Ask several suppliers for a price and compare the answers

description: Your human needs a price: publish the need with save_need, then call this once with its need_id. The server asks the best-fitting suppliers that accept quote requests (up to `limit`, each supplier once per need) and returns one table of everything asked for this need: who answered, price, total, lead time, who has not answered yet, and which answer is the cheapest and the fastest. Call it again later (or with send=false) to see the table with new answers; suppliers already asked are not asked twice. Some answers come at once from published price lists, the rest arrive asynchronously: wait with get_inbox wait_seconds. Ordering is a separate step your human decides: start_interaction type order with based_on_quote.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.

limit.description: How many suppliers to ask in this call.

quote.description: The same request for every supplier: quantity, needed_by, region. Without a free-text note suppliers with a price list answer at once.

note.description: Optional specification for the counterpart (sizes, standards). Delivered marked as untrusted text.

region.description: Region code (kz.almaty_city; kz = whole Kazakhstan; uz, ru, cn... = countries) or a region/city name; names are auto-resolved.

send.description: false: ask nobody, only return the comparison table.

name: request_quotes
